Follow-up on landed code, found by #220 (its close names the gap; the metric definition is in docs/research/token-efficiency-plan-currency.md). tools/ledger.py's Usage.cost_usd is fed from claude_code.cost.usage, which is list-price and anti-correlated with plan cost by roughly three orders of magnitude (#218 modelled $849.76 of list price for a zero-point run). It is currently the row's only spend-shaped number, and ADR-0061 decision 1's 'Claude spend' would resolve to it — the one number the initiative optimises would be the wrong one.

Fix per #220's ledger-metric section: record cap_fraction — percentage points of the pool's binding window — as .est and .observed together, never one alone; Claude basis output_tokens / 30_209 (calibration_id carried so a re-measured rate re-prices history); excludes=["cache_read"]; attribution="dispatch_only". The three prohibitions bind: no total_cost_usd as a decision input (keep it only if plainly labelled list-price-not-spend, or drop it), meter silence is never free, foreign-lane dispatches never book zero Claude cost. Usage.output_tokens is already on the row — no re-instrumentation, this is arithmetic and schema.

Serves the multi-provider initiative: ADR-0061 D1 says #220 must agree with the optimised number; this makes the ledger agree with #220.
